cleansingStrength.rationale: Strong: Sodium Laureth Sulfate #2 with the betaine only after salt and Parfum (Cocamidopropyl Betaine #5), chelator Tetrasodium EDTA #18, and no conditioning counter-signal at all; explicit deep-cleansing intent ('Tiefenreinigung' in name). C1's moderate ruling requires no reset/deep-cleansing intent and meaningful buffering, so it does not apply; the strong anchor's clarifying architecture with net strong effect fits.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Only one anionic route; betaine still buffers; claims cannot assign cleansing alone (3.2).

conditioningLevel.rationale: Low: no cationic polymer, silicone, lipid or humectant cluster; Hydroxypropyl Methylcellulose #13 is a thickener.

weightPotential.rationale: Low: no deposition route; strong reset.

focusPrimary.rationale: Clarifying: 'Tiefenreinigung' in the product name, 'entfernt Ablagerungen', 'Klären & Glänzen'; the stripped SLES architecture is compatible (7.2).
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Blind: lean SLES, no conditioning, chelator -> clarifying-compatible. Unblind: name 'Tiefenreinigung' -> clarifying.

focusSecondary.rationale: Empty: the shine claim ('& Glanz') has no independent smoothing/film route; it is an outcome of removing deposits with the same cleansing route (§8 condition 2, F2).
focusSecondary.counterSignal: Shine is in the product name.

usageRole.rationale: Occasional_reset: 'Tiefenreinigung' in the product name triggers the D1 lexicon (§9); cleansing strong.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: No scalp-comfort positioning; heavy fragrance and citrus oil.

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 W low, C low: fine ideal, normal ideal, coarse acceptable. T4: no neighbors -> no flags.
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1: strong + occasional_reset + clarifying primary -> clarifying (I2 kept; amber). I3: neighbor moderate -> regular, equal to the normal bucket's expected intensity -> review_intensity_boundary.
projection.deepCleanserRationale: D1 true ('Tiefenreinigung' in product name, E1 high). D2: strong + clarifying + occasional_reset + D1 -> flagged; regular-shampoo rows kept. Confidence = min(cleansing moderate, focus high, usage moderate, D1 high) = moderate.
projection.liveComparison: Not evaluated (live rows not in sealed packet).

uncertainties: Same C1 vs 3.2 tension as L10: a single-anionic SLES/betaine formula becomes strong only through deep-cleansing intent; chose strong (neighbor moderate). With moderate, D2 would fail and D3 (review_reset_positioning_mismatch) would fire.

Shine as a named secondary benefit of a clarifying product: 7.1 lets shine be low-conditioning ('acidic alignment'), but every shampoo contains citric acid; the standard does not say whether pH adjustment alone is an independent shine route.
Positioning sources are retailer-only; D1 relies on the product name (E1 high).
